name: com.unity.template.ar-mobile
description: This template was developed for users new to AR development and is pre-configured with all of the necessary packages and settings for both Android and iOS development with AR Foundation. The template is immediately build ready: simply connect a properly configured mobile device then select Build and Run from the file menu. The sample scene contains coaching guides on what gestures to use to interact with the scene and a creation menu with a list of spawnable objects.
